# Rule 5: Interacting with players who have disconnected or entered SSD Players in SSD are players who have disconnected from the game. Examining them displays: “They stare blankly into space and do not respond to anything. They may come to their senses soon.”
This may be caused by connection problems or other technical issues. Nobody enjoys being killed or stripped of their belongings because of this. Antagonist assassination objectives are intended to be difficult and engaging. Killing a player in SSD is interesting for neither the killer nor the victim. If your target is in SSD, do not hesitate to ask the administrators for help through Ahelp.
- Do not touch or interact with players in SSD except to take them to cryo, provide medical care, or rescue them from immediate danger, such as carrying them out of a fire. - Likewise, a player in SSD with the “Wanted” status may not be detained without an administrator's permission. - If a player enters SSD during or immediately after being detained, you may continue the detention and arrest. - Likewise, if you are an antagonist and your target enters SSD immediately after you attack them, you may continue. - If you believe the situation requires interacting with a player in SSD, such as retrieving important equipment from the captain, use Ahelp first.
